news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹2.25 (vs ₹2.02 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹2.25 (up from ₹2.02 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹973.6m (down 2.6% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹35.0m (up 11% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 3.6% (up from 3.1% in 3Q 2025). The increase in margin was driven by lower expenses. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 50% per year but the company’s share price has only increased by 37% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings growth.

news.title: Active Clothing Co Limited announced that it expects to receive INR 57.5 million in funding from Stellant Securities (India) Limited and other investors
news.body: Active Clothing Co Limited announced a private placement of 2,000,000 warrants at a price of INR 28.75 per warrant for gross proceeds of INR 57,500,000 on January 27, 2026. The warrants will be convertible into one common share of the company at INR 86.25 per share and will mature in 18 months from the date of the allotment. The securities will be issued on preferential basis. The transaction has been approved by the board of directors of the company. The transaction included participation from new investors Stellant Securities (India) Limited for 300,000 warrants, Mangala Subhash Rathod for 300,000 warrants, Subhash Phootarmal Rathod for 400,000 warrants, Rajesh Mehra for 400,000 warrants, Renu Mehra for 400,000 warrants, Kalika Mehra for 200,000 warrants.
